title: The Silent Mill
description: Millbrook's watermill has mysteriously stopped working. Miller Oswin swears the gears are sound and the water flows true, yet the great wheel refuses to turn. Forty-one people live in Millbrook and this is the only mill any of them have - no wheel means no flour, and no flour before the passes close means a winter spent on whatever the hunters bring in instead of bread.

objectives.description: Check the mill's water channel for obstructions
Break the totem or make peace with what's behind it - either way, get the wheel turning before first snow

notes: Threat made concrete using millbrook_elder.json's canon figure (forty-one people, one mill). Consequence stated in the last objective: the wheel has to turn before first snow or the town grinds no flour all winter. resolve_curse is a single interact objective, not a branch, so both readings (removing vs. appeasing the obstruction) share the same outcome text: the mill runs again. No new objective, flag or choice_consequences added.
